descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在清迈尝过khao soi后写的菜单，先记了菜名，等汤面吃好才补上结尾。
descriptions.en: My khao soi menu from Chiang Mai. The name came first; the ending waited until after the soup and noodles.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在清迈尝过sai ua后留下的小菜单，菜名旁的逗号记着自己吃饭时的一次停顿。
descriptions.en: A menu after sai ua in Chiang Mai, with a comma for a pause I took over lunch.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在素贴寺露台眺望清迈，我先看近处再看远处，把自己的停步顺序记在这张纸上。
descriptions.en: My personal sequence from a Doi Suthep terrace view over Chiang Mai: nearby first, farther away next.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在清迈尝泰北香草肠时，我放慢了正要说的话，自己的菜单上便多了一小个逗号。
descriptions.en: A small comma from slowing a sentence over herb sausage in Chiang Mai.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在清迈拉查帕皇家花园，我和旅人各指一个方向，却都决定先看看眼前。这是我们自己的路记。
descriptions.en: Two personal arrows from Royal Park Rajapruek in Chiang Mai. We pointed different ways, then both paused right where we were.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我把在素贴寺眺望清迈的记忆折在两面：先看这里，再看远处。小卡只记录自己的观察顺序。
descriptions.en: My Doi Suthep view over Chiang Mai, folded into “Start here” and “Then look farther.” A homemade memory, one side at a time.
